title: Taiwan's New N700ST Bullet Train Reaches 170 km/h in First Main-Line Test
summaryZh: 台灣高鐵新車N700ST首次主線測試，時速達170公里
summaryHi: ताइवान की नई N700ST बुलेट ट्रेन ने पहले मेनलाइन परीक्षण में 170 किमी/घंटा की गति छुई; जुलाई 2027 से यात्री सेवा।
summaryEs: El nuevo tren bala N700ST de Taiwán alcanza 170 km/h en su primera prueba en la línea principal; llevará pasajeros desde julio de 2027.
summaryJa: 台湾高速鉄道の新型N700STが初の本線試験で時速170キロに到達、2027年7月に営業運転へ。
summaryKo: 타이완 고속철 신형 N700ST, 첫 본선 시험에서 시속 170km 달성… 2027년 7월 운행 시작 예정.
summaryEn: Taiwan's new N700ST bullet train hit 170 km/h in its first main-line test and should start carrying passengers in July 2027.
paragraphs: Taiwan's newest bullet train has passed an important early milestone. Taiwan High Speed Rail Corporation (THSRC) said its N700ST train reached 170 kilometres per hour during its first test on the main line early on Monday morning.
The run took place between Zuoying and Chiayi stations in the south of the island. According to the operator, the train hit its testing target, which means the project remains on schedule.

THSRC ordered 12 of the trains from Japan, and the first one was delivered on 15 August. Before it is allowed to carry the public, it has to pass 69 separate safety and equipment checks. Engineers are examining everything from the brakes, doors and electrical systems to the onboard computers, the automatic train control system and the air conditioning.
In a press release, the company said the first three N700ST trains should enter passenger service on 1 July 2027. The full set of 12 is expected to be running by September 2028.

Once all of them are in use, the fleet will grow to 46 trains, and capacity during peak hours will rise by 25 percent. For commuters who often stand on crowded weekend and holiday trains, that could make a real difference.
Taiwan has a new high-speed train. It is called the N700ST. On Monday, it made its first test trip on the main line.
The train went between Zuoying and Chiayi in the south of Taiwan. It reached 170 kilometres per hour. This was the goal for the first test.

Taiwan High Speed Rail bought 12 of these trains from Japan. The first one came in August. Before it can carry people, it must pass 69 safety tests. Workers will check the brakes, the doors, the computers and the air conditioning.
The first three new trains will start carrying passengers on 1 July 2027. All 12 should be working by September 2028.
Then the company will have 46 trains. At the busiest times, trains will have room for 25 percent more people.
sentZh: 台灣有一款新的高鐵列車。

時速達到 170 公里。
這正是第一次測試的目標。
台灣高鐵向日本買了 12 列這種列車。
第一列在八月抵達。
在載客之前，它必須通過 69 項安全測試。
工作人員會檢查煞車、車門、電腦和空調。
首批三列新車將於 2027 年 7 月 1 日開始載客。
12 列應會在 2028 年 9 月前全部上路。
屆時公司將擁有 46 列列車。
在最繁忙的時段，列車可多載 25% 的乘客。

paragraphs: Taiwan High Speed Rail Corporation (THSRC) has tested its newest bullet train on the main line for the first time. Early on Monday, the N700ST train reached a speed of 170 kilometres per hour.
The test took place between Zuoying and Chiayi stations in southern Taiwan. The company said the train met its target, so the plan is still on schedule.

THSRC ordered 12 N700ST trains from Japan. The first one arrived in Taiwan on 15 August. Since then, engineers have been checking it carefully. It must pass 69 different safety and equipment tests before it can carry passengers. These include tests of the brakes, doors, electrical systems, onboard computers and air conditioning.
According to the company, the first three trains will start service on 1 July 2027. All 12 should be running by September 2028.
When that happens, THSRC will have 46 trains in total. The number of passengers it can carry at peak hours will increase by 25 percent, which should make busy journeys more comfortable.

測試在台灣南部的左營站和嘉義站之間進行。
公司表示列車達到了目標，因此計畫仍按時程進行。
台灣高鐵向日本訂購了 12 列 N700ST 列車。
第一列於 8 月 15 日抵達台灣。

它必須通過 69 項不同的安全與設備測試，才能載運乘客。
這些包括煞車、車門、電力系統、車載電腦和空調的測試。
據公司表示，首批三列將於 2027 年 7 月 1 日開始營運。
12 列應會在 2028 年 9 月前全部上線。
屆時台灣高鐵總共將有 46 列列車。
尖峰時段的載客量將增加 25%，應能讓繁忙時段的旅程更舒適。

The run took place between Zuoying and Chiayi stations in the south of the island. According to the operator, the train hit its testing target, which means the project remains on schedule.

THSRC ordered 12 of the trains from Japan, and the first one was delivered on 15 August. Before it is allowed to carry the public, it has to pass 69 separate safety and equipment checks. paragraphs: Taiwan's next generation of bullet trains has cleared its first major hurdle on the tracks. Taiwan High Speed Rail Corporation (THSRC) announced that its new N700ST train reached 170 kilometres per hour in an initial main-line trial in the early hours of Monday, hitting the target set for the run.
The trial was conducted on the stretch between Zuoying and Chiayi stations in southern Taiwan. The operator stressed that the result keeps the rollout firmly on schedule.

THSRC has ordered a dozen N700ST trains from Japan, the first of which arrived on 15 August. That unit is now undergoing a demanding programme of 69 safety and equipment tests before it can be cleared for passengers. The checks cover a wide range of systems, including the electrical supply, brakes, doors, onboard computers, automatic train control and air conditioning.
According to a company press release, the first three trains are scheduled to begin carrying passengers on 1 July 2027, with all 12 expected to be in operation by September 2028.

When the order is complete, the fleet will expand to 46 trains, boosting peak-hour capacity by 25 percent. For a railway that is frequently packed at weekends and during holidays, the extra room is likely to be welcomed by travellers.
sentZh: 台灣新一代高鐵列車已在軌道上跨越第一道重大關卡。
台灣高鐵公司（THSRC）宣布，其新款 N700ST 列車於星期一凌晨的首次主線試驗中達到時速 170 公里，達成這趟試車設定的目標。
試驗在台灣南部左營站與嘉義站之間的路段進行。
營運商強調，這項結果讓新車上線進度穩穩維持在時程內。
台灣高鐵向日本訂購了十二列 N700ST，其中第一列已於 8 月 15 日抵達。
該列車目前正在接受嚴格的 69 項安全與設備測試計畫，之後才能獲准載客。
檢查涵蓋多種系統，包括供電、煞車、車門、車載電腦、自動列車控制和空調。
根據公司新聞稿，首批三列預定於 2027 年 7 月 1 日開始載客，全部 12 列預計於 2028 年 9 月前投入營運。
訂單全部交付後，車隊將擴充至 46 列，尖峰時段運能提升 25%。
對於週末和假日經常爆滿的鐵路來說，多出來的空間很可能受到旅客歡迎。

paragraphs: Taiwan's high-speed rail network has taken a significant step towards modernising its fleet. Taiwan High Speed Rail Corporation (THSRC) reported that its new N700ST train attained a speed of 170 kilometres per hour during its inaugural main-line test early on Monday, thereby meeting the benchmark set for the trial.
The test was carried out between Zuoying and Chiayi stations in the south of the island. Crucially, the operator indicated that this outcome means the project is proceeding on schedule.

The company has purchased 12 N700ST trains from Japan, the first of which was delivered on 15 August. Before entering service, this train must successfully complete 69 rigorous safety and equipment assessments. These evaluations encompass the electrical systems, braking, doors, onboard computers, the automatic train control system and air conditioning, reflecting the stringent standards expected of high-speed transport.
According to an official press release, the first three trains are due to commence passenger operations on 1 July 2027, while the entire order is expected to be operational by September 2028.

Upon completion, the fleet will comprise 46 trains, enhancing peak-hour capacity by 25 percent. Given that demand frequently exceeds supply on busy routes, this expansion is likely to alleviate congestion and improve the overall passenger experience.
sentZh: 台灣的高速鐵路網在車隊現代化方面邁出了重要一步。
台灣高鐵公司（THSRC）報告指出，其新款 N700ST 列車在星期一清晨的首次主線測試中達到時速 170 公里，從而達成這次試驗設定的基準。
測試在島嶼南部的左營站與嘉義站之間進行。
關鍵在於，營運商表示這項結果意味著計畫正按時程推進。
公司向日本購買了 12 列 N700ST，其中第一列於 8 月 15 日交車。
在投入營運之前，這列車必須順利完成 69 項嚴格的安全與設備評估。
這些評估涵蓋電力系統、煞車、車門、車載電腦、自動列車控制系統和空調，反映出高速運輸應有的嚴格標準。
根據官方新聞稿，首批三列預定於 2027 年 7 月 1 日開始載客營運，而整批訂單預計於 2028 年 9 月前投入運作。
全部完成後，車隊將由 46 列列車組成，尖峰時段運能提升 25%。
由於繁忙路線的需求經常超過供給，這次擴充很可能紓解擁擠，並改善整體乘客體驗。
